name: Inter + JetBrains Mono
keywords: inter, sans, mono, code, developer, clean
description: Inter for UI and JetBrains Mono for code; the default developer-tool stack.
usage_or_notes: Dashboards, docs, dev tools. Scale 12/14/16/20/24/32/48; mono for numeric columns.

name: Playfair Display + Source Sans
description: High-contrast serif display against a neutral sans body; headline elegance.
usage_or_notes: Editorial and fashion. Playfair only >=32px; caps letter-spacing 0.01em.

name: IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono
keywords: ibm plex, plex, technical, enterprise, engineered
description: Everything-Plex engineered look with matching mono and optional serif siblings.
usage_or_notes: Enterprise and B2B. Use Plex Sans Light for large headers, Medium for CTAs.

name: DM Sans + DM Serif Display
description: Geometric sans with a high-contrast DM Serif for landing headlines.
usage_or_notes: Startup marketing sites. Pair 900-weight DM Sans CTA buttons with serif hero.

name: Fraunces + Karla
keywords: fraunces, retro serif, karla, warm, soft
description: Punchy old-style display serif with a quiet grotesque body copy.
usage_or_notes: Brand sites, food, coffee. Enable Fraunces optical sizing; Karla line-height 1.6.

name: Space Grotesk + IBM Plex Sans
description: Techy grotesque display plus neutral body; sparkly but readable.
usage_or_notes: Web3, data tooling. Space Grotesk headings 600; avoid below 16px copy.

name: Sora + Inter
description: Sora rounded geometric headings with Inter body for friendly-tech feel.
usage_or_notes: Fintech and productivity apps. Sora 800 for heroes, Inter 400/500 UI text.

name: Merriweather + Open Sans
keywords: merriweather, open sans, readable, blog, serif body
description: Serif reading body with humanist sans UI; classic content pairing.
usage_or_notes: Blogs and long-form docs. Merriweather 17px/1.75 body, Open Sans for nav.

name: Oswald + Lato
keywords: oswald, condensed, lato, bold poster, headline
description: Condensed uppercase headline stack with airy Lato body text.
usage_or_notes: News, sports, events. Oswald tracking 0.02em, never full sentences in caps.

name: Libre Baskerville + Proxima
description: Traditional bookish serif with a clean geometric sans; trust-building tone.
usage_or_notes: Legal, education, government. Baskerville headings ~1.5em, letter-spacing 0.5px.

name: Fira Code + Noto Sans
keywords: fira code, noto, multilingual, ligatures, i18n
description: Ligature-rich code face plus the widest-coverage humanist sans for i18n.
usage_or_notes: Globalized products and IDE-adjacent docs. Noto covers 120+ scripts; keep line-height 1.62.

name: Cormorant Garamond + Poppins
description: Light luxury serif with geometric sans UI labels; couture contrast.
usage_or_notes: Luxury and hospitality. Cormorant 500 for hero, Poppins 300/500 for buttons.

name: Söhne-like Satoshi + Logi
description: Crisp contemporary grotesque with tight tracking and neutral tone.
usage_or_notes: Brand-led startups. Satoshi 700 hero -0.03em tracking; mate a mono for prices.

name: Source Serif 4 + System UI Stack
keywords: source serif, system ui, fall back, performance, zero download
description: Serif display with the zero-download system stack for body; fastest pairing.
usage_or_notes: Performance-critical or offline-first. System stack saves network; serif only for h1-h3.
